item.description: Spread the loveMarvel Studios continues to peel back the curtain on Avengers: Doomsday with a striking new teaser that may be its most enigmatic yet. This time, the spotlight shifts to Shuri, M’Baku, Namor, and Ben Grimm, also known as The Thing. The four stand together in a vast desert landscape, surrounded by endless sand…
